summary: Nez Perce NF lookout at 7,260 ft: 35-ft platform tower with a log cabin, built 1932; now gone, and no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 35-foot platform tower with a log cabin; L-5 log cabin on a log crib per firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts, two-story per Forest Lookouts
facts.status_note: Cabin and tower have since departed (firelookout.com); Idaho Fire Lookouts and the Idaho lookout list also mark it gone

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as hike-in; no source describes the site today or whether it is open to the public

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts describe an L-5 log cabin on a log crib; Forest Lookouts describes a two-story log cabin. The story reports both descriptions.

notes_for_editor: Brief county 'Idaho' matches the Idaho lookout list, so no correction. Elevation 7,260 ft from firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts. The removal date and cause are not stated in any source, so no removal event is recorded. One WebSearch found nothing about this lookout. Site today not described by any source. Idaho Fire Lookouts' 'hike-in' is the only access statement; access level left unset. No photo URL was found, so no photos are listed.
